purpose: Check whether the Linux static daemon's RSS keeps growing beyond the 200-frame steady-state sample
binary: symbrowse v0.15.0 linux_arm64 release archive (cosign-verified), not the 8e1898c82 CI build
environment: python:3.12-slim container (Docker on the macOS development host), isolated HOME/XDG, loopback fixture
workload: static daemon, alternating daemon.ping and fetch.url, 5 warmup pings, VmRSS from /proc after each mark
reading: Transient warm-up peak at 200 frames, then a plateau about 3 MB above start that stays flat to 4000 frames: bounded, not a leak.
